channel.title: Social Save Journal
channel.description: Guides to saving videos, Reels, Shorts and photos.

item.title: How to Copy a Video Link From Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube
item.description: A step-by-step guide to copying a video link on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, on phone and computer, plus how to tell short links from full ones.

item.title: How to Save Instagram Reels: 4 Ways Compared
item.description: Four ways to save an Instagram Reel: Instagram's own Save, downloading your own Reels, a link-based downloader and screen recording. Pros, cons and limits.

item.title: How to Save Facebook Videos: Official and Link-Based Options
item.description: How to save Facebook videos: use Save for later, download your own uploads, or use a link-based downloader for public videos. Limits, privacy and fixes.

item.title: How to Save TikTok Videos (and What the Watermark Means)
item.description: How to save TikTok videos with TikTok's Save button, Favorites or a link-based downloader, what the TikTok watermark is, and why some videos cannot be saved.

item.title: How to Save YouTube Shorts: Official Options First
item.description: How to save YouTube Shorts: Save to playlist, YouTube Premium offline downloads, downloading your own Shorts in YouTube Studio, and when a link tool makes sense.

item.title: Is It Legal to Download Social Media Videos?
item.description: A plain-language guide to copyright, platform terms and personal use when you save videos from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or YouTube. Not legal advice.

item.title: Best Free Stock Photo and Video Sites (and How to Read Their Licences)
item.description: Where to find free stock photos and videos, such as Pexels, Pixabay and Unsplash, and what to check in a licence before you use an image or clip.

item.title: MP4 vs WebM vs MOV: Which Video Format Should You Save?
item.description: MP4, WebM and MOV compared in plain language: compatibility, file size and when to choose each. Includes a short guide to JPG, PNG and WebP images.

item.title: Where Do Downloaded Videos Go on Android? Find, Organise and Free Up Space
item.description: Where downloaded videos and photos are stored on an Android phone, how to find them with Files by Google or your gallery, and how to organise and free up space.
